no_adcom_quote.quote: An Advisory Committee Meeting was not held for this topical product.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for LUZU (luliconazole, NDA204153). The review documents state the application was not discussed before an advisory committee because this new azole antifungal presented no novel or complex scientific or regulatory issues requiring outside expertise, and raised no primary safety or efficacy concerns. With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
